title: Fast 14-hour breakout in a 60h/180h uptrend, flat within the day

source.title: tradingstrategy.ai learn pages (Donchian/trend), via lab hypothesis H-009

rule_summary: Chart 1h, closed bars only, signal at bar close, fill at next open. REGIME: SMA(60) > SMA(180) and close > SMA(60). ENTRY: regime holds AND close > highest high of the prior 14 bars (excluding current) AND no open position AND 2 bars passed since the last exit. EXIT at bar close when close < lowest low of the prior 6 bars OR close < SMA(60). STOP: fixed 2% below entry (native). No take-profit. DAY-TRADE FRAME (same for every fast variant): entries only on bars opening 00:00-16:00 UTC, at most 2 entries per pair per UTC day; any open position is sold at the open of the 23:00 UTC bar or 12 hourly bars after entry, whichever comes first (never held overnight). Long only, spot, one position per pair, no pyramiding.
mechanism: A breakout of a short range inside an intraday uptrend: the parent's 7-day breakout and 30d/90d regime compressed by 12. Momentum after a break tends to run for hours; the 6-bar low exit cuts failures. Fast variant of a tried rule: the parent holds days or weeks; this one is forced flat within the day so the dry-run reaches 60 trades in weeks. Costs (0.30% round trip) are NOT relaxed.
